policy: One working vertical slice and one real browser demonstration at a time; no mandatory research report cycle.

phases.goal: A complete, professional interactive Create/Learn/Assistant UX prototype; build real controls/flows first, clearly mark not-yet-live engineering checks and LLM actions
phases.acceptance: Owner can navigate all core flows on desktop and 1024px, select parts, wire, inspect, learn, and see contextual feedback; no dummy clickable controls pretending to save/verify

phases.goal: Connect supported UI actions to Python CircuitSnapshot/net/verifier via typed API
phases.acceptance: One source-backed FAIL → correction → scoped PASS and UNKNOWN with real scene replay

phases.goal: Versioned snapshots/layout state and local save/reopen
Use preserved educational feedback and transfer logic in real UI
phases.acceptance: One independent task measured against deterministic outputs

phases.goal: LLM interpretation with evidence context envelope and explicit action approvals
phases.acceptance: Replays are source-grounded; no phantom source, false verdict, unauthorized edit

phases.goal: Expand to sensor families and CitySense-style projects
phases.acceptance: Catalog-driven multi-instance components rather than hardcoded 4 devices
